blurb: Jazzle Dance Studio offers dance classes for children ages 2-12, focusing on developing dance skills, technique, and performance. Classes include ballet, jazz, hip-hop, and tumbling/acrobatics, with opportunities for exams and competitive company training. They also provide dance programs in schools to promote creativity and physical fitness.
